subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Names items of clothing and describes their function, who wears them and why

show.line: We wear clothes! A shirt, a dress, pants, socks, shoes and a hat.

rounds.prompt: What do we wear on our feet?
What do we wear on our head?
What do we wear when it rains?
What are you wearing today? Name one thing.

rounds.praise: A firefighter! It keeps her head safe.

hints: Think where on your body it goes.
Clothes keep us warm, dry or safe.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put on my socks.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: My socks go on my hands!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Socks go on our feet.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Socks on our feet. Gloves on our hands!

parent_line: Can name clothing items and say what they are for.
